description: Get Vastu Shastra placement guidance for ONE room type in a specific (or proposed) compass zone — whether it is compliant, the severity if not, the recommended zone, and the remedy. One dedicated backend endpoint per room type. Use vastu_audit_floor_plan instead to check a whole building at once.

zone.description: The compass zone this room is placed (or proposed to be placed) in.

name: vastu_room_placement
